functions.name: claim
functions.doc:
Pay the caller the deposits of every prediction it holds that has been scored, less its
 board row's storage the first time (`Stats.storage_owed`), and forget those predictions
 (their record stays in the market counts, the board and the logs). Returns the amount sent.
 Caller: a predictor. Deposit: none. Panics: "nothing to claim".

functions.name: get_board
functions.doc:
The board: up to `TOP_N` accounts with at least `MIN_RANKED` scored calls, ranked by right
 minus wrong, then account; `limit` (at most 100) from rank `from`. Reads at most `TOP_N`
 rows whatever the number of predictors. View: anyone, no deposit, no panics.

functions.name: get_config
functions.doc: The arena account, the deposit and the bounds. View: anyone, no deposit, no panics.

functions.name: get_duel_markets
functions.doc:
Every market of a duel with at least one prediction: the duel market first, then chaos
 markets by index. View: anyone, no deposit, no panics.

functions.name: get_market
functions.doc:
One market's crowd split and outcome; `None` before its first prediction. View: anyone,
 no deposit, no panics.

functions.name: get_predictions
functions.doc:
The predictions `account` holds, oldest first: open ones and scored ones not yet claimed.
 Claimed ones live on in `get_stats` and the `predict` / `settle` logs. View: anyone, no
 deposit, no panics.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: get_stats
functions.doc:
`account`'s scored record; `None` before its first non-void verdict. View: anyone, no
 deposit, no panics.

functions.name: on_predict
functions.doc:
`predict`'s callback: stores the prediction if the market is still open, else sends the
 deposit back. Returns whether it was accepted. Never panics, so a refused deposit is never
 kept. Caller: this contract (private).

functions.name: on_settle
functions.doc:
`settle`'s callback. Fixes, once, the outcome of each market of the duel the arena has
 decided: a chaos market when its injection left `Pending` (`Flipped`, `Held`; void on
 `NoTrial` or `Expired`; an outcome this contract does not know is left open), the duel
 market when the duel resolved (`A`, `B`, `Tie`; void when voided). The two answers are read
 apart: a failed or unreadable one (or a duel record for another id) settles nothing that
 depends on it, and the call panics, changing nothing, only when neither is usable. Then
 scores up to `SCORE_PAGE` predictions of settled markets, in order, and returns how many are
 still unscored. Caller: this contract (private).

functions.name: predict
functions.doc:
Call `pick` on a market: a chaos injection (`index` = its index in `get_chaos(duel_id)`,
 pick `Flipped` or `Held`; views `chaos_open` and `get_chaos`) or the duel (`index` =
 `None`, pick `A`, `B` or `Tie`; views `get_duel` and `duel_lock`). One call per account per
 market. Accepted in `on_predict` only if the arena's views show the market open (see the
 crate doc); otherwise the deposit goes back. Returns that promise.
 Caller: anyone. Deposit: exactly `DEPOSIT`. Panics: "attach exactly the deposit", "pick does
 not fit the market", "index out of range", "predictions closed", "already predicted", "too
 many open predictions: claim first".

functions.name: settle
functions.doc:
Read the arena's `get_duel` and `get_chaos` for `duel_id`, then settle and score in
 `on_settle`. Caller: anyone. Deposit: none. Panics in the callback (changing nothing): "arena
 failed", "arena answer unreadable", "duel missing".

functions.name: void_stale
functions.doc:
Escape hatch for a market the arena never settles (nobody voids the duel, or its answers
 stop parsing): every market of `duel_id` still unsettled `STALE_NS` after its first
 prediction becomes void (refunded, not counted). Then scores like `settle` and returns how
 many predictions are still unscored. Caller: anyone. Deposit: none. No panics.

MarketView.description: The crowd's split on one market and, once settled, its outcome.

index.description: The chaos injection's index in `get_chaos(duel_id)`; `None` for the duel market.

open_until_reveal.description: Chaos market opened against an arena without `chaos_open`: it closes at the target's reveal, not at its commit, so whoever runs the target knows the outcome before it closes.

outcome.description: The winning pick; `None` while open, or when settled void.

picks.description: `Flipped`, `Held` for a chaos market; `A`, `B`, `Tie` for a duel market.

steered_by.description: Chaos market: the target's owner when the target is a keyed agent. That owner chooses which completion its agent signs, so it can steer the outcome. `None` for a keyless target, a duel market, or when the arena had no `chaos_open` view.

Pick.description: A call on one market. `Flipped` and `Held` go with a chaos injection, `A`, `B` and `Tie` with a duel (`A` and `B` are the duel's `a` and `b` agents).

PredictionView.description: One prediction an account still holds: open, or scored and not yet claimed.

Stats.description: One account's scored predictions (`Void` not counted).

storage_owed.description: The storage of this row, kept back from the account's next `claim` (then 0). The row outlives every prediction, so its owner pays it once instead of the contract.

streak.description: Right calls in a row, in the order they were scored (shown, not ranked on).

Verdict.description: How a scored prediction came out. `Void`: the market had no outcome; refunded, not counted.
